title: Tidy matters
summary: Get everything out of a matter in one go, fix a matter number, and clear out the matters and threads you no longer need.
body_markdown:
It’s now easier to get work into and out of a matter, and to keep it in order.


## Everything out in one go


- Download every thread in a matter at once, or all the documents in a thread as a single zip.
- Downloaded responses now include the prompt that produced them.


## Everything in, faster


Drag files or whole folders onto a matter’s client documents. If a file can’t be read, Parachute tells you which one.


## Housekeeping


- Edit a matter’s number after you’ve created it.
- Permanently delete matters and threads you no longer need.
